notes.title: October Update!
notes.content: It’s the spookiest month of the year everyone! That means having the chance to fight pumpkin enemies and more with this October update! This content will only be available for a short time, so make sure to play it while you can! I've also added in some permanent things to stay as well, such as new art and some bug fixes. Happy October everyone!

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Mostly just bug fixes and stuff. If you're encountering the glitch where you can't move upon playing, go into the key bindings in the main menu ("Options") and re-bind all the keys. All you have to do is click on them, and change it to what it was set to.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: As requested, I have added new key binding options in the main menu, new enemies in the Trials game mode, along with many bug fixes. Key bindings aren't completely implemented, so that means no text will change to the bindings you have selected in game, but they still work none the less! Hope everyone enjoys the update!

notes.title: Massive Update: Crypto’s Trials
notes.content:
Now features a whole new wave based game mode, 121 weapons, 614,000 costume combinations, new enemies, all new rooms to explore, and SO many bug fixes!  Along with all that, the first person to beat round 20 in Trials mode wins 5 free copies of the game! (See community page for more information).

Make sure to check out the trailer: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q2CF_sluwlM&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Update: Fighting Chance
notes.content: Hello everyone! Releasing a medium sized update with a completely revamped tutorial, many bug fixes, and the ability to see weapon stats for a weapon that is in a store case. All you have to do is walk up to a store case, and press “t” to see the stats! As of right now, it only works for weapons, but in future updates it will work for costumes too. Along with all this, though it hurts me to do this, the game has been made easier. Hope everyone enjoys!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Just a small update fixing some bugs, adding a new enemy, and tweaking the health regeneration system. Now, you regenerate health from going in doors, and regenerate health over time (up to a maximum of 3 health per hallway). Hope everyone enjoys!

notes.title: Update: Billy and Friends!
notes.content: I have added a big update for everyone! Now introducing allies, which can be picked up at certain shops. You no longer have to fight through the hallways alone! Along with allies, I've re-done the health system, instead of health regenerating over time; it now regenerates every time you go through a new door. Finally, I've added in a new side room to explore, along with the usual bug fixes. Hope everyone enjoys! Make sure to tell me what you think, you can usually find me in The Haunting of Billy group chat during the day!

notes.title: Update: Into the depths!
notes.content: I’ve released a massive update including a very improved menu, improved tutorial, multiple bug fixes, and a whole new set of hallways to explore, the depths! Which now includes the last boss, upon killing explains the story of the game, and gives you the last note! Good luck!
